Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class WorkspaceModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.WorkspaceModel
public final class WorkspaceModel extends Object
The pure model of multiple workspaces (virtual desktops) on the 2D/Swing desktop: a fixed number of workspaces, a current one, and which window lives where.

Windows are identified by a stable string id — the 2D shell uses Desktop2DWindow.getAppName(), which is unique among the open windows — so the model holds no Swing and no window references and stays deterministic and headless-testable. Desktop2D owns an instance and drives the MDI frame visibility, the taskbar window buttons and the WorkspacePager from it; the model itself never touches the desktop.

Because it is desktop-agnostic, the native 3D desktop reuses this same model: org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.workspace.WorkspaceRegistry keys it by Frame3D identity instead of MDI frame name and drives Frame3D visibility from it, so both desktops offer the same workspace count, wrapping and assignment semantics.

Indexes are 0-based and always wrapped into range, so switchTo, next and previous can never select a workspace that does not exist. The count is clamped to MIN_COUNT..MAX_COUNT; shrinking it pulls any out-of-range assignment and the current index back into range rather than dropping windows.
